audience: online shops and call centres that manage their orders in SalesDrive

useCases.title: Check today's orders and their status
useCases.text: List the orders placed in a date range, filtered by status or organization. List the order statuses to read the name and id of each status.

useCases.title: Look up an order and its payment and delivery options
useCases.text: Get one order by its order number. List the payment and delivery methods to read their names before you answer the client.

useCases.title: Find the manager for a caller's phone number
useCases.text: Search the client and the responsible manager by phone number. Then get the matching order by its number to see what the client bought.

useCases.title: Move an order to another status or manager
useCases.text: Update the status, responsible manager or comment of an order. Use the status id from the status list. Only the fields you pass change.

useCases.title: Add a call-back note to an order
useCases.text: Add a note to the client communications block of an order. Each call adds a new note, and the note gets the current time.
